import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

class Line {
  private constructor(
    readonly id: string,
    private readonly state: Record<string, unknown>,
  ) {}
  static create(id: string, state: Record<string, unknown>): Line {
    return new Line(id, state);
  }
  static rehydrate(id: string, state: Record<string, unknown>): Line {
    return new Line(id, state);
  }
  equals(other: Line): boolean {
    return this.id === other.id;
  }
  toState(): Record<string, unknown> {
    return { ...this.state };
  }
}

describe('Line', () => {
  it('is identified by its id, not by its attributes', () => {
    const first = Line.create('line-1', {});
    const same = Line.rehydrate('line-1', {});
    const other = Line.create('line-2', {});

    expect(first.equals(same)).toBe(true);
    expect(first.equals(other)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('gives back the state it was rehydrated from, as a copy', () => {
    const state = {};
    const stored = Line.rehydrate('line-1', state);

    expect(stored.toState()).toEqual(state);
    expect(stored.toState()).not.toBe(state);
  });

  it.todo('refuses to be created when one of its invariants is violated');
});
